eq-ch09-molecular-textbook: Textbook molecular flux of a minor species: gradient, own scale height and thermal-diffusion terms.
eq-ch09-molecular-centred-error: Truncation error of the centred mixing-ratio face flux on the own-scale-height profile: zero only for $H_i = H$, else $O(\delta z^2)$.
eq-ch09-rosenbrock-std: Ros2 in the textbook scaling $k_s = \gamma \Delta t\, \kappa_s$.
eq-ch09-rosenbrock-expansion: Taylor expansion of one Ros2 step with an arbitrary matrix $\mathsf L$, with general weights and stage coupling.
eq-ch09-rosenbrock-order: Order-2 conditions: they fix $b_1 = 3/2$, $b_2 = 1/2$, $\gamma_{21} = -2$ and involve neither $\mathsf L$ nor $\gamma$.
eq-ch09-rosenbrock-error: The embedded estimate $c^{1} - y_2$ is the $O(\Delta t^2)$ local error of the first stage.
eq-ch09-conservation-trim: Corrected budget trim: hogs lose atoms in proportion to their share, which removes exactly the excess.
eq-ch09-conservation-exact: Condition for the budget to be met exactly: the excess does not exceed the hogs' atoms.
eq-ch09-conservation-code: The trim at the pin: the hog total is floored at 1, so below 1 only part of the excess is removed.
